title: Foundry MCP Companion
description: Optional companion for the foundry-mcp-gateway MCP server. Runs the client-side actions the socket protocol alone cannot reach: execute macros, real system rolls (with Dice So Nice), camera pan/ping, one-shot sounds, player notifications, Campaign Codex API, and client telemetry (who sees what, selected/targeted tokens). No configuration needed — install it, and your MCP client gains client_* tools.
